purpose: Execute G6 as one fail-closed Decoder-owned chain while preserving stage-local preregistration, exact authority binding, durable resume, and adaptive-but-non-inventive R-series progression.

structural_series.freeze_rule: Each S-stage has a concrete preregistration before campaign launch; questions, observers, domains, alternatives, equality rules, budgets, evidence contracts, and promotion rules are immutable during the run.
structural_series.graduation_rule: S6 mechanical PASS never auto-graduates; independent verification and explicit graduation review remain separate authority events.

reconnaissance_series.adaptive_rule: The chain never invents an R question. It can only follow a preregistered branch with a concrete hash-bound question/executor; otherwise it pauses for review.
reconnaissance_series.early_close_rule: If no further scientifically justified question remains, close rather than consume unused R slots.
reconnaissance_series.extension_rule: R8+ requires an explicit new protocol amendment.

resource_policy.parallelism: Only independent registered work within a stage may use the worker lease; chain dependencies are sequential.

exactness.hash_role: Binding/indexing only; not a substitute for mathematical equality.
